standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that the localizations phi_{f} stay rig-smooth, reducing rig-flatness to the naive condition.

standard_prerequisites.name: Regular sequences on open subsets of V(J)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that it suffices to check J_q generated by a regular sequence at primes maximal for not containing an ideal of definition.

standard_prerequisites.name: Rig-closed points after localization and descent
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the rig-closed prime p' and the faithfully flat descent of regular-sequence generation and flatness along the displayed diagram.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibre regularity and Grothendieck regular sequence criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that f_1,...,f_m map to a regular sequence in the fibre, hence in the local ring, with flat quotient.

core_obligations: 约化一：phi_{f} 保持 rig-smooth（基变换或局部性），rig-flat 化归为 naively rig-flat（4471-4478 行）。
约化二：正则序列生成在 V(J) 的开集上判，取 q 极大 rig-closed；4505 行 details omitted 为 A_{f}{x} = A{x}_f 的完备-局部化交换标准恒等式（注记）；忠 flat 下降图（中间箭头局部+平坦⇒忠实平坦）（4481-4531 行）。
最终情形：经 equivalent-with-artin-smooth 取 f_1..f_m 生成 J_q 且 Jacobian 行列式在 q 处可逆；fibre regular + 导子扩张 + quotient-sequence-regular 得 F_q 中正则；grothendieck 准则得 A{x}_q 中正则且商平坦（4534-4557 行）。
proof_roadmap: rig-closed 极大素点与忠实平坦下降（4481-4531 行）。
Jacobian 可逆情形的正则序列收尾（4534-4557 行）。
